title: Make a Reservation
ritualsDesc: Discover traditional Latvian sauna rituals focused on deep relaxation and body cleansing. Experienced sauna masters customize each ritual and enhance your mental and physical well-being.
rentDesc: Enjoy a private sauna experience surrounded by forest tranquility. Perfect for peaceful getaways or memorable evenings with friends and family.
transportDesc: By bus from Riga to the "Dzimtmisa" stop – we collect you there free of charge (choose it when booking). Or choose the transfer from Riga and back – €70.
